topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon an envelope tucked away in a drawer, the kind we never explore together. It was labeled simply, "My Bucket List." My eyes scanned the paper, each item a whisper of dreams I never knew. There, in his handwriting, were the milestones he longed to reach, some so different from what I imagined for us. I feel the weight of this paper, the intimacy of it. I should take it back, place it where I found it, yet part of me hesitates, curious about the man I thought I knew completely. I tuck the list back, smoothing over the creases, wishing the day would just rewind.
